script.title: AT THE TAILOR
script.story_hook: New pants, wrong length, one interview tomorrow morning.
script.intro_zh: 新褲子長度不對，明天上午就要面試。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the tailor shop today. Listen for fitting and alteration words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的裁縫店。留意試穿和改衣的說法。
script.outro: Pinned, priced, and ready by eight. Listen twice and repeat each line.
script.outro_zh: 別針固定、報價完成、明早八點可取。聽兩遍再逐句跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the whole fitting, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來逐句跟讀這整段試穿對話。
script.char_a_description: a young professional woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length auburn hair in a low bun, a cream blazer over a gray top, holding a pair of long navy dress pants, average build
script.char_b_description: an elderly man in his early seventies with thinning gray hair and a neat gray mustache, a tan cardigan over a checked button-down shirt, reading glasses hanging on a cord, a short round build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you hem pants here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju hɛm pænts hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你們這裡修改褲長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do. What seems to be the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du wʌt simz tə bi ðə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These new pants are way too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz nu pænts ɑɹ weɪ tu lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這條新褲子實在太長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long have you had them?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju hæd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 這條褲子你買了多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought them yesterday for an interview.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɔt ðɛm ˈjɛstɚdeɪ fɚ æn ˈɪntɚvju/
dialogue.zh: 我昨天買的，為了面試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An interview? Then length really matters.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈɪntɚvju ðɛn lɛŋθ ˈɹɪli ˈmætɚz/
dialogue.zh: 面試？那褲長就真的很重要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. They pool at my ankles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðeɪ pul ət maɪ ˈæŋkəlz/
dialogue.zh: 就是說啊，褲腳都在腳踝堆起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pool? Show me how you wear them.
dialogue.phonetic: /pul ʃoʊ mi haʊ ju wɛr ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 堆起來？讓我看看你平常怎麼穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I try them on right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɹaɪ ðɛm ɑn ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我要就在這裡試穿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the fitting room is just through there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈfɪɾɪŋ ɹʊm ɪz dʒʌst θɹu ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，試穿間就在那後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, be right back.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bi ɹaɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我馬上回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand straight for me. Feet relaxed.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd stɹeɪt fɚ mi fit ɹɪˈlækst/
dialogue.zh: 站直給我看看。雙腳放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I look? Like this, or taller?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ lʊk laɪk ðɪs ɔɹ ˈtɔɫɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我看起來怎麼樣？這樣，還是再挺一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taller, perfect. Now, how short do you want them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɔɫɚ ˈpɝfɪkt naʊ haʊ ʃɔɹt du ju wɑnt ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 再高一點，完美。現在，你想改多短？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want them to just touch the shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ðɛm tə dʒʌst tʊtʃ ðə ʃu/
dialogue.zh: 我想讓褲管剛剛碰到鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's called a slight break, very standard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kɔld ə slaɪt breɪk ˈvɛɹi ˈstændɚd/
dialogue.zh: 那叫做輕微折痕，非常標準。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Break? Like the fabric bends a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪk laɪk ðə ˈfæbɹɪk bɛndz ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 折痕？就是布料會稍微彎一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. No break means it floats above the shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt noʊ breɪk minz ɪt floʊts əˈbʌv ðə ʃu/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。不折就是懸在鞋面上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, which one looks more professional?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wɪtʃ wʌn lʊks mɔɹ pɹəˈfɛʃəənəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，哪一種看起來更專業？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For interviews, a slight break is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ˈɪntɚvjuz ə slaɪt breɪk ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 面試的話，輕微折痕最保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slight break, please. Can I keep my shoes on?
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪt breɪk pliz kən aɪ kip maɪ ʃuz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 那就輕微折痕。我可以穿著鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll pin it while you stand there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl pɪn ɪt waɪl ju stænd ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，你先站著，我用別針固定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the pins are cold!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə pɪnz ɑɹ koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 噢，別針好冰！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about that, almost done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt əˈloʊst dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，快好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how much is one hem?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz wʌn hɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那個，改一次褲腳多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen dollars, and we do both legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ˈdɑɫɚz ænd wi du boʊθ lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 十五塊，兩邊褲腳都做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair. When can I pick them up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ wɛn kən aɪ pɪk ðɛm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 很合理。我什麼時候可以來取？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normally it takes three days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔɹməli ɪt teɪks θɹi deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 通常要花三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days? The interview is tomorrow morning!
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi deɪz ði ˈɪntɚvju ɪz təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 三天？面試明天上午就有！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that's a problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæts ə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那是個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything we can do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ wi kæn du/
dialogue.zh: 我們還有辦法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, there's rush service for ten extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɛɹz ɹʌʃ ˈsɝvɪs fɚ tɛn ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有急件服務，多加十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would it honestly be ready by tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt ˈɑnəstli bi ˈɹɛdi baɪ təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真的能在明天之前完成嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By eight tomorrow morning, guaranteed.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɛɪt təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˌɡæɹənˈtid/
dialogue.zh: 明早八點前，保證完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Can I pay now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil kæn aɪ peɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。我可以現在付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, is there a jacket too?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈdʒækɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 等等，還有外套要改嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, actually. The sleeves feel a bit long.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈæktʃuəli ðə slivz fil ə bɪt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對耶，袖子感覺有點長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it here... yes, two inches too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ɪt hɪɹ jɛs tu ˈɪntʃəz tu lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 拿到我這裡……嗯，長了兩吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can that be done by tomorrow too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðæt bi dʌn baɪ təˈmɑɹoʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 那個明天也能一起改好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, sleeves are twenty, rush included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ slivz ɑɹ ˈtwɛnti ɹʌʃ ɪnˈkluːdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 可以，袖子二十塊，含急件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Total would be forty-five with the rush?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəl wʊd bi ˈfɔɹti faɪv wɪð ðə ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 連急件費總共四十五，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see: fifteen, twenty, ten... yes, forty-five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ləts si fɪfˈtin ˈtwɛnti tɛn jɛs ˈfɔɹti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我們算一下：十五、二十、十……對，四十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're quick at math, I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ kwɪk æt mæθ aɪ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你算得好快，我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tailors count all day, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɫɚz kaʊnt ɔl deɪ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 裁縫整天都在數數字，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, here's my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hɪɹz maɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 好，這是我的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it right here, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ɹaɪt hɪɹ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請在這裡碰一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Do I get a claim ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn du aɪ ɡɛt ə kleɪm ˈtɪkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好了！會給我取件單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a text when it's ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊl ɡɛt ə tɛkst wɛn ɪts ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 完成時你會收到訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I text you if plans change?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt kæn aɪ tɛkst ju ɪf plænz tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。如果時間有變，我可以傳訊給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Good luck with the interview.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ði ˈɪntɚvju/
dialogue.zh: 當然。面試加油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, something fell on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɛl ɑn ðə flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，好像有東西掉到地板上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the floor... here it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə flɔɹ hɪɹ ɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我看看地板……在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, stepping on that would hurt!
dialogue.phonetic: /uː ˈstɛpɪŋ ɑn ðæt wʊd hɝt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，踩到那個可就痛了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No harm done, this happens every week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hɑɹm dʌn ðɪs ˈhæpənz ˈɛvɹi wik/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，這種事每個星期都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I'll see you tomorrow at eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪl si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那明天八點見，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight o'clock, and bring the shoes you'll wear.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt əˈklɑk ænd bɹɪŋ ðə ʃuz jʊl wɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 八點整，記得帶你那天要穿的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, these sneakers aren't interview material.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ði ˈsnikɚz ɑɹənt ˈɪntɚvju məˈtɪɹiəl/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，這雙球鞋不適合面試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try them on before you leave, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ ðɛm ɑn bɪˈfɔɹ ju liv oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 離開前記得再試穿一下，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thank you so much!
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。真的非常感謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go get that job. See you tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɡɛt ðæt dʒɑb si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 去拿下那份工作。明天見。

script.youtube_title_en: "Slight Break, Please" — Rush Pants Hemming at the Tailor
script.youtube_description:
「三天？面試明天上午就有！」新買的褲子太長，裁縫說要三天，這種情況用英文怎麼辦？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，場景就在老裁縫店的試穿鏡前。

你會聽到：怎麼描述褲長問題（They pool at my ankles.）；什麼是 slight break 折痕、怎麼請店家別針試量；問價位、急件費、取件時間的完整往來；還臨時追加外套袖子長度的加法報價。

整段都是 A2 初級短句，都是美式自然語感：well、deal、good call。聽完你就會用：Do you hem pants here?、How much is one hem?、Is there anything we can do?、Can I pay now?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，下次改衣服就用英文開口。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Three days? The interview is tomorrow morning!" Brand-new pants, wrong length, and only one day to fix it: what do you say at the tailor? This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right in front of the fitting mirror.

You will hear: describing the length problem (They pool at my ankles.); learning what a slight break is and getting pinned while you stand; asking about prices, rush fees, and pickup times; and adding a jacket sleeve fix to the same order.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences with natural American fillers like well, deal, and good call. By the end you'll own phrases like Do you hem pants here?, How much is one hem?, and Is there anything we can do?

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and walk into your next tailor visit ready.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
面試就在明天上午，新褲子卻長到堆在腳踝，走進裁縫店的第一句該怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進老裁縫店，從試穿、別針量長、認識 slight break 折痕，到急件費、臨時追加外套袖子，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
👖 描述問題：These new pants are way too long.
📏 選長度：I want them to just touch the shoe.
⏱️ 趕時間：Is there anything we can do?
🧾 追加訂單：The sleeves feel a bit long.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 deal、good call、let's see 這種真實語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這條褲子走一趟，下次站在試穿鏡前，該問的句句都開口。

祝你每一次試穿，長度剛剛好。
